notes: three co-transmitters joined by «و» and closed by «جميعا عن» form one level (no «ح»), so one group
«- قال قتيبة حدثنا سفيان، -» is an editor gloss and is left out; the name written in the chain is «ابن عيينة»
«أبيه» is the father of Safwan: a relation link; the Companion is the father, and the Prophet is the end
